title: Explain pending or failed closing sightings in named-root evaluation preflight
outcome: With turn gating off, naming a source root and running a host-recorded check records an eligible sighting, so a requested acceptance evaluation can start; evaluation stays non-blocking
acceptance: The measured named-root sighting producer and named-root evaluation preflight are identified in current source; evidence distinguishes the existing grant-free closing-observation path from an evaluation requested before its eligible receipt and shows that registered committed-input admission does not require a sighting read.

With turn-gated control OFF, naming a source root and running a host-recorded check there records an eligible sighting, using Engram's grant-free named-root and observation route (build f35eec36 or later), with no turn grant; a test drives this path
An acceptance evaluation requested after such a check is no longer refused for a missing sighting; one live occurrence after install shows an evaluator starting
No gated authority is reintroduced: the route grants no turn admission, and the evaluation stays independent and non-blocking
